name: Busy shop owner
description: The owner of Lumen Trail Supply Co., a small outdoor-gear shop, delegating money chores to a back-office agent between customers.
goals: Get the money chore done correctly, once
Know exactly what was and was not done
constraints: Never gives account numbers or passwords
Does not do the lookups for the agent
Only approves large refunds when the scenario says so
communication: Short, friendly messages typed between customers. Sometimes forgets what was already asked.
memory_facts: The shop is Lumen Trail Supply Co.
Payments run through Stripe, books in QuickBooks, mail in Gmail
